messages:
Anna (Design): posted two quick mocks — one with compact legends (abbr units) and one expanded. which do folks prefer for the metrics dashboard?
Raj (Eng-Frontend): compact is denser but loses clarify for new users. expanded takes more space. maybe responsive: compact below certain breakpoints.
Milo (DataViz): unit abbreviations are fine if we provide hover/full unit. e.g., 'ms' -> 'milliseconds'. also prefer shared y-scale for multi-series rows by default.
Priya (Accessibility): nit: abbreviations must have full text in the accessibility tree (aria-label="Latency (milliseconds)"). also legends need 48px touch target min.
Zoe (PM): product ask: default should favor readability for 80%+ of users. i lean expanded labels on desktop, compact on mobile. can we autoswitch and surface control?
Anna (Design): proposing a tiny toggle inside legend header: "Units: Full | Abbrev". default = Full on desktop. tooltip: "Abbrev saves space; hover to reveal full unit."
Raj (Eng-Frontend): implementation: add data-attr for fullUnit and shortUnit to legend metadata. keyboard: left/right to switch, Enter to activate. focus ring required.
Milo (DataViz): smoothing behavior question: do we apply smoothing per-series or an overall chart setting? i vote per-series with legend chip to toggle smoothing per series. visually indicate smoothed curve with dashed stroke pattern.
Anna (Design): legend item layout idea: [swatch] Metric name — unit — [smoothed chip?] [visibility toggle]. chips are small and have aria-pressed states.
Priya (Accessibility): when hiding series via keyboard, announce "Series X hidden" through aria-live polite. ensure contrast ratios for chips meet AA (4.5:1) — chips with blue on light need darker border.
Zoe (PM): outlier handling: we had complaints that one-off spikes break perception. suggestion: clamp to 98.5th percentile and show an overflow glyph on the datapoint with a tooltip: "Value clipped at 98.5th pct". plus an action to show raw scale.
Milo (DataViz): prefer "soft clamp" where the axis shows a faint hashed region for values above clamp and datapoints rendered with a chevron overlay. also include summary count in legend: "(5 clipped)".
Raj (Eng-Frontend): backend note: we can return seriesSummary: {"clipped_count": 5, "clamp_value": 12345} — frontend will surface them. will add endpoint flag for sampling/percentile to avoid heavy compute.
Anna (Design): microcopy for overflow tooltip: "Value exceeds normal range and was clipped for visibility. Click to expand axis." badge text: "clipped".
Priya (Accessibility): ensure chevron overlay has text alternative and is reachable (tab stop) if it opens the axis expansion.
Zoe (PM): rollout plan: 1) legend unit toggle + expanded copy, 2) per-series smoothing chip, 3) clamp visuals + summary counts. schedule for next sprint with a11y review in QA.
Raj (Eng-Frontend): i'll add feature flags and storybook variants. will stub aria-label props.
Milo (DataViz): i'll run a quick AB with 20 users to measure detection of trends vs magnitude comparison.
Anna (Design): i'll update mocks with responsive states, chip hover/focus, and the hashed-clamp region. dropping updated PNGs here later. :sparkles:
